implemented_response_handling.behavior: Assign one saved response to each call under a lock and record the message.
Optionally signal started and wait for release outside the lock.
Read JSON from the assigned UTF-8 fixture.
If error is present, raise MockProviderError using its message.
Otherwise return the saved reply unchanged, including refusal or interrupted completion markers; these are mock markers, not a supported live-provider protocol.
